text: 454 Mathesis is a main-belt asteroid discovered by German astronomer Friedrich Karl Arnold Schwassmann on March 28, 1900, with the provisional designation 1900 FC. Photometric observations conducted at the Altimira Observatory in 2004 revealed a light curve featuring a period of 8.37784 ± 0.00003 hours and a brightness variation of 0.32 in magnitude. This period contrasts with earlier reported values of 7.075 hours from 1994 and 7.745 hours from 1998. This article on an asteroid native to the asteroid belt is a stub and can be expanded with additional information.
